what_it_does: lsCOMP is a GPU-accelerated data compressor designed to handle the enormous data streams from X-ray light sources. These facilities generate data at 250 gigabytes per second today and will reach 1 terabyte per second by the end of the decade. The compressor enables both lossless compression (no information loss) and lossy compression (with controlled precision reduction) to reduce storage and transmission bottlenecks.
